uncited: The scene includes a camera with perspective projection.
The splat data is stored as attributes on a glTF mesh primitive.
**POSITION** (`VEC3`): The mean vector $\mu$ in local space.
**ROTATION** (`VEC4`): Unit quaternion $(q_x, q_y, q_z, q_w)$ in glTF order.
**SCALE** (`VEC3`): Linear spread $(s_x, s_y, s_z)$ along local principal axes.
Degree 1 has 3 coefficients, Degree 2 has 5, Degree 3 has 7.
*   Degrees must be fully defined; partial definitions are invalid.
Compute the 3D covariance matrix $\Sigma$ in global space.
Evaluate the spherical harmonics at the viewing direction to determine the RGB color.
Sort splats by distance to the camera origin.
*   **Time Complexity:** Linear in the number of splats $N$ and the number of pixels $P$ covered by splats.
Rasterization is $O(N \cdot k)$ where $k$ is the average number of pixels per splat.
*   **Memory Complexity:** $O(N)$ to store splat attributes. $O(P)$ for the image buffer.
*   **Performance:** Real-time performance is achievable on modern GPUs due to the simplicity of the Gaussian kernel and efficient rasterization.
Artifacts can occur with large splats or improper sorting.
*   **When to use:** Real-time visualization of large scenes, virtual reality, interactive applications.
*   **When not to use:** Scenes with very high frequency details that require many splats, or when memory is extremely constrained.
